known.basis: CLIProxyAPI places the cache markers on requests from Claude logins itself and asks Anthropic for the 1-hour cache.
A Claude API key gets Anthropic's default 5-minute cache; the 1-hour cache only when the client asks for it.
A Claude API key with the claude-code-cli fingerprint profile is treated like a login: CLIProxyAPI asks for the 1-hour cache.
